description: R-SQL-1 fixture r-sql-1-accdb-main: tables L, R, RX, LD, NS, E, TX, S, N, ND, NB, AG, AGI and [T Space], and saved queries QL, QL2, QU3A, QU3B, with the rows written in RSql1.Build. Created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128); DDL and literal rows go through Database.Execute, exact typed values (Double bits, Single, Currency, Date, embedded NUL) through table-type AddNew/Value/Update. Every statement's outcome is captured (a refused type such as BIGINT in MDB is an observation) and the closed file is kept.

CREATE TABLE R (rid LONG CONSTRAINT PK_R PRIMARY KEY, lid LONG, qty LONG)
CREATE TABLE RX (rid LONG CONSTRAINT PK_RX PRIMARY KEY, lid LONG, qty LONG)
CREATE TABLE LD (n LONG CONSTRAINT PK_LD PRIMARY KEY, id LONG)
CREATE TABLE NS (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_NS PRIMARY KEY, v LONG)
CREATE TABLE E (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_E PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE TX (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TX PRIMARY KEY, t TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE [T Space] ([Order] LONG, [Col Name] TEXT(10))
